checks.evidence: verify defaults: no FAIL. finite, peak -1.00 dBFS, dc -64 dB, loop_seam PASS (wrap discontinuity 0.45x of max 2, spectral change 3.4 dB of max 6), all 3 macro claims PASS, rebuild PASS. summary warnings: none.

time_shape.evidence: Loop, exactly 5.000 s, no leading/trailing silence. Density 13 events/s (64 fine onsets in 5 s) at seed 1; seeds 2-4: 11, 12, 16 events/s, all at or above the brief's 5/s. Spread across the whole loop (the spectrogram shows streaks throughout); steadiness spread 5.4 LU (-23.5 to -18.1 LUFS), no decay or attack ramp. Weakest stretch: seed 1 around 1.5-2.0 s has 2 events/s (a gap of about 0.6 s between 1.14 and 1.75 s).

spectrum.evidence: Energy shares: <200 Hz 59%, 200-2k 21%, 2k-8k 14%, >8k 7%. 63/125/250 Hz bands sit at -27.5/-25.6/-27.4 dB, 8-12 dB above the 500 Hz band (-36.5), so the roar is under 300 Hz (strongest mode 48 Hz, -19 dB). 4k and 8k+ bands at -30.2/-31.2 dB across all five time segments = a steady hiss floor. Centroid 1.57k/2.42k/1.60k Hz is pulled up by crackle and hiss, as expected of a roar plus hiss. No movement is required by the brief.

parts.evidence: All three are visible in the spectrogram. Roar: continuous orange band below 250 Hz, whole length. Crackles: vertical streaks 1-8 kHz (onsets rise to about 6 dB above the floor, 4 ms apart, short attack 0-25 ms), with spikes in the waveform. Hiss: a flat haze above 4 kHz at -30 to -31 dB in every segment, and the heat=0 sweep removes it (8k+ drops to -44 dB) while the roar stays, showing they are separate layers. The 500 Hz-2k gap between roar and crackle is clearly dark (1k about -37 to -44 dB), which separates the parts.

control_variation.evidence: 3 macros (busyness, weight, heat), all claims PASS: busyness density 2.0 -> 8.0 -> 11.0 -> 13.2 -> 15.8 /s; weight centroid 3.3k -> 882 Hz; heat centroid 241 -> 3.9k Hz. Seeds 1-4 differ measurably: density 13/11/12/16 per s, crest 18.9/18.3/18.2/18.5 dB, mid centroid 2.42k/1.54k/1.70k/1.32k Hz, density-by-tenth patterns all different. All four keep at least 11 events/s, the roar under 200 Hz at 58-65%, and the hiss band near -31 dB.

notes: The whole sound is one `fire` node plus output, so the roar, crackle and hiss are not separate nodes and cannot be edited or soloed apart.
busyness=0 gives 2 events/s and heat=0 removes the hiss (8k+ -44 dB, centroid 241 Hz): the extreme ends of the knobs leave the brief, but the default position and 0.5 and up stay inside.
Seed 1 has a lull at 1.5-2.0 s (2 events/s) and a mid-loop centroid bump (2.42k Hz), so it is the least even of the four seeds.
